title: One Piece
tagline: One Piece is a decentralized bucket where users deposit their NFTs in the vault and mention NFTs they are willing to swap with theirs.
description: One Piece is a decentralized bucket where users deposit their NFTs in the vault and mention NFTs they are willing to swap with theirs. The bucket will actively look out for any match between two distinct users. Our Dapp will automatically exchange the NFTs when there is a match between two users; thus, users get their desired NFTs without actively golfing for them on marketplaces.
how_its_made:
This project is made using an order matching algorithm where NFTs get swapped whenever there is an order match.
The dapp can also process complex orders where a user can deposit one NFT and also mention the wanted NFTs list.
Deployed on polygon Mumbai testnet. A first-time user will also get an NFT.
We have used NFT Port to upload images to IPFS.
